story: Toronto led by 14 in the third. Cunningham's step-back three put Detroit up 102–101 with 19.8 left.
aria: Animated Short: Scottie Barnes drives for the go-ahead layup with 14.3 seconds left, assisted by Immanuel Quickley, to put the Raptors up 103–102 at Detroit. Raptors win 105–102. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
